texts.preamble: Shree Bishnu Dal Mills Association & Anr vs 9.12.17 State Of West Bengal & Ors on 19 December, 2017 Author: Debangsu Basak Bench: Debangsu Basak 1 W.P. No.30198 (W) of 2017 Shree Bishnu Dal Mills Association & Anr. v. 19.12.17 State of West Bengal & Ors. Sl-13 Ct-13 Mr. Ranjan Bachawat (S.R.) Mr. Shwashish Sen Gupta
texts.facts: The grievance of the petitioners is non-issuance of licence under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 as also the trade licence under the Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act, 1980.
texts.arguments: Learned senior advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that, under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 read with the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, an officer of the Kolkata Municipal Corporation, 1980 is designated for the purpose of considering and granting a licence under the Act of 2006 and also for considering exemption.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned senior advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that, under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 read with the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, an officer of the Kolkata Municipal Corporation, 1980 is designated for the purpose of considering and granting a licence under the Act of 2006 and also for considering exemption.
